headline: Executive order signed March 31, 2026, aimed at verifying citizenship and protecting integrity in federal elections.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order deals with checking that people voting in federal elections are U.S. citizens. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies, and requirements it sets are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: The order's title suggests it may involve steps to confirm voters' U.S. citizenship, but the details are not available.
Officials who run federal elections may be affected if the order sets citizenship verification steps, though the specifics are not stated.
